title: NeuronGen: Neural Network Parameter Generation via Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.12470v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Acquiring the parameters of neural networks (NNs) has been one of the most important problems in machine learning since the inception of NNs. Traditional approaches, such as backpropagation and forward-only optimization, acquire parameters via iterative data fitting to gradually optimize them. This paper aims to explore the feasibility of a new direction: acquiring NN parameters via large language model generation. We propose NeuronGen, a generalized and easy-to-implement two-stage approach for NN parameter generation conditioned on descriptions of the data, task, and network architecture. Stage one is Parameter Reference Knowledge Injection, where LLMs are pretrained on NN checkpoints to build foundational understanding of parameter space, whereas stage two is Context-Enhanced Instruction Tuning, enabling LLMs to adapt to specific tasks through enriched, task-aware prompts. translated_title: NeuronGen：基于大语言模型的神经网络参数生成
translated_abstract: 自神经网络（NN）诞生以来，如何获取神经网络的参数一直是机器学习领域最重要的课题之一。传统方法（如反向传播和仅前向优化）通过迭代拟合数据来逐步优化参数。本文旨在探索一个新方向的可行性：通过大语言模型生成来获取神经网络参数。我们提出了NeuronGen，这是一种通用且易于实现的两阶段方法，可以基于数据、任务和网络架构的描述来生成神经网络参数。第一阶段是参数参考知识注入，即让大语言模型在神经网络检查点（checkpoints）上进行预训练，以建立对参数空间的基础理解；第二阶段是上下文增强的指令微调，使大语言模型能够通过丰富的、任务感知的提示词来适应特定任务。实验结果表明，NeuronGen能够有效地……
tldr: 本文提出NeuronGen，一种通过参数参考知识注入和上下文增强指令微调两阶段方法，利用大语言模型根据数据、任务与网络架构描述直接生成神经网络参数，开辟了替代传统迭代优化的新方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NeuronGen, a two-stage approach (Parameter Reference Knowledge Injection and Context-Enhanced Instruction Tuning) that enables large language models to directly generate neural network parameters conditioned on data, task, and architecture descriptions, exploring a new direction beyond traditional iterative optimization.
